title: Pre-registered single frozen-set evaluation of conservative gate v1 on photo_a_001
status: Registered BEFORE the run. This file is committed before run_eval.py / eval_synthetic.py are executed with the gated arm. The run is executed ONCE; its results are reported whatever they are, and no gate parameter may be changed in response to them.

how_it_was_chosen.data: CC0REF validation split only (542 photos, each clean and with one synthetic degradation; night/sunset tags from machine captions). The detector was fitted on 1000 CC0REF TRAIN photos. DEV-22 not used for selection. PH-1 and HO-SYN not used; no PH-1 image was viewed while choosing.
how_it_was_chosen.swept: predicted-change deadzone (1-5 dE00), detector threshold (0.4-0.7), with and without scene constraints, and combinations (results/gating_v1/validation/summary.md). Scene-constraint thresholds were NOT swept: they were set once, before the study, as the protocol limits with margin.
how_it_was_chosen.selection_rule: Among validated gates, maximise recovery retained on degraded validation photos subject to: share of clean validation photos with dE00 <= 3 at least 0.90, and night-tagged and sunset-tagged failure rates each at most 0.10.

runs: cd experiments/auto && OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 lockf -k /tmp/lightly-heavy.lock python run_eval.py --manifest manifests/ph1_manifest.csv --faces manifests/ph1_faces.json --arms gated:runs/photo_a_001@gating/gate_v1.json --out results/heldout_v1_gate_v1/ph1 --threads 2

cd experiments/auto && OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 lockf -k /tmp/lightly-heavy.lock python eval_synthetic.py --manifest manifests/cc0ref_manifest.csv --arms gated:runs/photo_a_001@gating/gate_v1.json --out results/heldout_v1_gate_v1/hosyn --threads 2
comparators: Original, control and ungated photo_a_001 are NOT re-run; their frozen-set results are the committed results/heldout_v1/{ph1_photo_a_001,hosyn_photo_a_001}.

hypotheses.H1_ph1_already_good: S1 PASS on already_good (class mean dE00 <= 3 and >= 80% of images pass).
hypotheses.H5_ph1_backlit: S1 FAIL on backlit is EXPECTED: a gate only scales the model toward identity and cannot raise a subject the model darkens.
hypotheses.H6_hosyn_identity: HO-SYN identity samples: mean dE00 to input <= 1.5.
hypotheses.H7_hosyn_recovery: HO-SYN degraded samples: upper bound of the 95% CI of mean dE00 to clean is below the unchanged input's mean (8.71), i.e. the gated model still recovers some degradation.

interpretation_fixed_in_advance: Passing H1-H4 and H6 would show the gate meets preservation limits on these public held-out sets. It would NOT show that the gated model improves photos: the unchanged Original passes the same limits. Improvement needs the preference study.
Whatever the outcome, the model is not shipped and Auto stays an unresolved release requirement. PH-1 is not a T1 G0 set.
After this run PH-1 has been scored for two candidates. Any further gate or model iteration informed by these results must be evaluated on a new frozen set.
descriptive_reported_without_hypothesis: Per class: share of PH-1 images the gate leaves exactly unchanged (strength 0), and mean strength, read from per_image.csv arm_info. On DEV-22 (development data) the gate acted on only 4 of 22 photos, so a pass on preservation limits may largely reflect abstention; this share is what tells the two apart.
HO-SYN: share improved vs input and share worse by > 1 dE00 on degraded samples; share of identity samples <= 1.5.
